description: Observed San Francisco Bay Area targets for BPIR on the full-scale MTC model
source: MTC Travel Model One v0.3 Calibration & Validation Technical Report (DRAFT May 17 2012): Table 55 'Number of Trips - Target' (BATS-2000-scaled observed trips by trip mode x tour purpose); Table 8 (Year 2000 households, nine-county Bay Area)
scoring_conventions: purpose scored on final_trips.primary_purpose (tour purpose) - matches the report's tour-purpose accounting; no 'home' category
college+school -> school; atwork -> othdiscr (same PURPOSE_MAPPING as the paper)

modes aggregated to the paper's five categories; DA->Driver, SR2+SR3+->Passenger, Walk, Bike, all transit submodes->Public Transit; ride-hail/taxi excluded from the mode marginal (not in 2000 observations)
identical Eq.(1) composite: w=0.25/0.40/0.35, alpha_trip=2.0, alpha_dist=4.0
